listing.name: Simple Supercapitals
listing.summary: Adds single-hulled supercapital ships for each tech level that are more durable and powerful than average large capital ships but cost more upfront and have higher upkeep.
listing.aiSummary: Adds single-hulled supercapital ships for each tech level that are more durable and powerful than average large capital ships but cost more upfront and have higher upkeep.

description:
BETA RELEASE

v0.9.1

This is a mod that takes a simpler take to supercapital ships, going for single hulled vessels without modules, making them more comparable to large capital ships with way more OP and durability than average. You naturally pay for this with a larger up-front price, and increased upkeep.

This includes one for each tech level, as well, so whichever your preferred style is, there should be something that appeals to you!

Ship Stuff in spoiler

Spoiler

Imperator Battleship

Originally commissioned alongside the Onslaught to provide the role of a more efficient dreadnought than the older, less efficient designs. The ship would be updated and modernized throughout its life, alongside that of the venerated Onslaught. Designed to match the firepower of entire fleets, the Imperator would eventually be phased out, in favor of smaller, more mass producible designs. Nevertheless, several vessels survived up to and past the collapse, proving how some large vessels never truly fell out of favor.

Megalodon Battlecarrier

A vessel designed by Altair Exotech to fill out their capital lineup of naval procurement. Standing as an odd departure from the Cruiser School Altair was designing ships for, the Megalodon leans more into the Domain’s decisive battle doctrine. The Megalodon was one of the few cruiser school ships to grab the positive attention of Domain Navy Admirals, being a powerful strike craft platform centered heavily on large weapons platforms. Even with its carrier focus, it sacrifices little speed or firepower and was considered a Battlecarrier in naval doctrine.

Theia Battlecruiser

Designed in secret by several megacorporations with input and technical expertise from Altair Exotech. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation has the completed ship. These vessels have been spotted patrolling the Hybrasil System as early as the First AI War, though no detailed scans of the vessel have ever been performed, so the full capabilities of the vessel are unknown.
